description: This PHP class defines the LDAPSetting data transfer object (DTO) for configuring LDAP connection and synchronization settings in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like host, port, encryption, implementation, and methods for serialization/deserialization, validation, and configuration management.

classes.name: LDAPSetting
classes.description: Data transfer object encapsulating LDAP configuration settings including connection, security, and synchronization parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LDAPSetting with host, port, implementation, encryption, and default data mapping.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an LDAPSetting instance from a JSON string representation.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes LDAPSetting instance to a JSON string.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server host.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server host.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server port.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server port.

methods.name: getEncryption
methods.description: Returns the encryption type used for LDAP communication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Sets the encryption type for LDAP communication.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the LDAP implementation type.

methods.name: setImplementation
methods.description: Sets the LDAP implementation type.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: isOptReferrals
methods.description: Checks if LDAP referrals option is enabled.

methods.name: setOptReferrals
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP referrals option.

methods.name: isBindAnonymously
methods.description: Checks if anonymous binding is enabled.

methods.name: setBindAnonymously
methods.description: Enables or disables anonymous binding.

methods.name: getBindUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name for LDAP binding.

methods.name: setBindUserDN
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name for LDAP binding.

methods.name: getBindUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the LDAP bind user password.

methods.name: setBindUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the LDAP bind user password.

methods.name: isEnable
methods.description: Checks if LDAP integration is enabled.

methods.name: setEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP integration.

methods.name: shouldMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Checks if LDAP users should be merged with existing system users.

methods.name: setMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Sets whether to merge LDAP users with existing system users.

methods.name: getSyncInterval
methods.description: Returns the synchronization interval.

methods.name: setSyncInterval
methods.description: Sets the synchronization interval.

methods.name: getDataMapping
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user data mapping.

methods.name: getUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user lookup settings.

methods.name: addUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Adds a user lookup setting.
